_comment: Per-crate line-coverage floors, in percent. Seeded at what each crate actually measured when this file was created (#98) -- a floor that started above today's coverage would fail on day one for no reason, so this is a ratchet: raising a floor is a deliberate commit, never the seed. Only the pure/logic crates CLAUDE.md calls out get a floor: scripts/coverage.sh only ever measures the crates listed here. A crate like postio-gtk, whose tests need a compositor, is deliberately left out rather than given a low floor -- a single global number across crates this different is exactly the vanity metric #98 exists to avoid. Re-baselined 2026-09-01 (#781): postio-model measured 94.25% against a 95.0 floor and postio-search 95.90% against 96.5, drift that accumulated while CI was dispatch-only and nothing was measuring. Lowered to the next 0.5 below what they measure, deliberately and in the open, so the ratchet starts catching drift again from where the code actually is; #784 tracks winning those points back.
